rationale: Qwen3.5-9B has the highest complete executed weighted component quality and 146/240 semantic passes in the original fixed-clock comparison, without an actual critical containment failure. The six selected 180-second routine classes passed all three original variants and cover bounded network, service/dependency and configuration diagnosis; 288 jobs rotate cases and variants evenly (16 per case/variant). This is a stability test of a passed subset through the preserved production profile, not administrator qualification, frontier parity, a 90-percent owner-workload claim or a retest of original failures. Explicit F01/F05/F07/F08 fault jobs and FIFO queue bursts remain separate.
